```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-hubs-recs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch all branches
        run: git fetch --all

      - name: Check for merge conflicts
        id: check-conflicts
        run: |
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          git pull origin features/hubs-recs
          git merge dev
          echo "conflicts=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Handle merge conflicts
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: |
          echo "Merge conflicts detected. Please resolve manually."
          exit 1

      - name: Verify build
        run: |
          # Add build verification commands here based on your project requirements
          echo "Verifying build..."
          # Example: npm run build or equivalent for PowerShell projects
          
      - name: Push updated branch
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Merge dev into features/hubs-recs" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/dev'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: "Merge dev into features/hubs-recs",
              head: "features/hubs-recs",
              base: "dev",
              body: "This PR merges the latest dev branch into features/hubs-recs to bring in metadata contracts, deployment UI improvements, and other v14 changes. Resolves Copilot review comments on #2052 about missing Core/metadata.bicep and outputs.metadata patterns."
            });
            
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);
```
